textRun.content: Full-Stack Product Engineer · Developer Tools & Infrastructure
I’m a product-minded engineer, founder, and developer-tools builder in Nigeria.
Open-source billing infrastructure for SaaS and AI products
Built subscriptions, usage metering, credits, feature gates, and provider-agnostic payment flows.
Shipped the TypeScript SDK and CLI, SvelteKit dashboard, and Cloudflare Workers API backed by Durable Objects and Workflows.
Designed a configuration-first developer experience for defining plans, checking entitlements, tracking usage, and self-hosting.
Owned end-to-end development across Agentspec, Checkit, and iLearnCloud, from customer discovery and strategy to design, implementation, and customer presentations.
Built AI-agent workflows and integrations, biometric attendance and authentication systems, and frontend product experiences.
Operated as the primary product engineer across three products, turning ambiguous customer needs into shipped software.
Re-platformed the frontend from React to Next.js.
Introduced a reusable design system and rebuilt the product interface.
Built a multi-cloud observability pipeline spanning AWS, GCP, and Azure.
· Open-source localhost tunneling with a Bun CLI, edge routing, automatic reconnection, and Cloudflare Durable Objects.
· Coding agent spanning CLI, web, and mobile clients, persistent sessions, workspace awareness, and pluggable model providers.
· Python SDK for stateful agents with typed tools, MCP, WebSockets, SSE, RPC, and multi-provider support.
